name: Trigon Prism
descriptionTemplate: Whenever a card enters the {Ultra Space}, draw [Arg1] Command Cards belonging to This card's owner from the Draw Pile. If unable to draw, gain an equal amount of Arithmetica instead. This effect can trigger at most 2 times per turn.
lore: "The light is composed of seven colors."
